samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Frequency Divider</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign CLK_50 = ~CLK_50;
        <assign CLK_10 = cnt_10 == 4 ? ~CLK_10 : CLK_10;
        <assign CLK_1 = cnt_100 == 49 ? ~CLK_1 : CLK_1;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic for CLK_50
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                CLK_50 <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                CLK_50 <= ~CLK_50;
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for CLK_10
        reg [2:0] cnt_10;
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                CLK_10 <= 1'b0;
                cnt_10 <= 3'd0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt_10 == 3'd4) begin
                    CLK_10 <= ~CLK_10;
                    cnt_10 <= 3'd0;
                end else begin
                    cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Sequential logic for CLK_1
        reg [6:0] cnt_100;
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                CLK_1 <= 1'b0;
                cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt_100 == 7'd49) begin
                    CLK_1 <= ~CLK_1;
                    cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
                end else begin
                    cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1;
                end
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
</module>
